# Hanword interoperability fixture

`basicsReport.hwp` is an unmodified test fixture from
[hahnlee/hwp.js](https://github.com/hahnlee/hwp.js/blob/main/packages/parser/src/__tests__/data/basicsReport.hwp),
retrieved September 10, 2026. The upstream project distributes it under Apache
License 2.0; the license is included in `LICENSE-hwpjs.txt`.

SHA-256: `6458ad26537739d68b93bf264c9d0c08b05b47e7fdff59b81f14586c31740ced`

It exercises actual Hanword record layouts, nested tables, captions, fonts,
numbering, headers, footers, and embedded images. It is test data, not shipped
with the browser application. Other binary and HWPX cases are generated by
`tests/helpers/hwp-fixtures.js` without third-party document content.
